decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9266. Series context: trend strength 0.9997 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.643.
